text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Hishi 
Amazon...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy boy! Wanna try checking out 
that family restaurant we saw on the ad in 
front of the station the other day?
choice_data_list: It's a BBQ restaurant, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Eating nostalgic American food, and 
the homework my old man gave me—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking for clues about "what's truly 
important in cooking"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Now then, what should I order? ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian. Even if you don't like vegetables, 
at least drink some carrot juice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... None of your business. I can 
decide what I eat myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian and Hayahide! Well, what a 
coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Hishi Ama-kun and her Trainer, is 
it? Hello. Looks like you're having lunch 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Come on, Brian, say hello too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Ama-san, please shut my sister up. 
She's being way too nagging.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean 'nagging'? Your race is 
coming up, so I'm just reviewing your 
nutrition..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, let's call it there. Why 
don't we all just sit down and enjoy a 
meal together?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm stuffed. That was actually 
pretty good!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Still, you know...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, nope, not a clue. The answers to 
homework don't come that easily...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Homework...? To think you'd bother with 
such things—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ama-san, did you eat something bad?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, all I've been eating is 
BBQ! There's a reason for this, you see...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—That's it! Why don't we ask Brian and 
Hayahide too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you folks think is the 'most 
important thing in cooking'?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What's important... in cooking? Hmm, let's 
see. I'm not exactly an expert, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Above all, what matters most is the 
"recipe." Starting from the basic 
formulation, you add your own twist 
through precise calculations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I view them as the basics and their 
application, if you will.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. Food is food as long as it's 
edible.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
However, it is what builds our flesh and 
blood. It should be filled with a fighting 
spirit, something that stirs you up when 
you devour it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see. Different opinions between the 
older sister and younger sister—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Cool technique combined with a fiery 
fighting spirit, is it?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... They're both good references, meow, 
but as for the one that sparks that 
special feeling...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're going with that one, Trainy?! 
I'm not great at using my noggin for the 
little details, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Recipe first! Guess there's nothing to it 
but to try! Brian, Hayahide, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me. I'll be cheering you 
on alongside Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't just lump me in with you.

Afterward, we returned to the academy, 
but... Hishi Amazon asked me, "Please wait 
for me in the Trainer's office."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep ya waitin', Trainer-boy. 
Here's a dish made with ultra-cool 
technique—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Chilled Tomato and Basil Pasta." Eat it 
before it gets warm!

Taking a bite of Hishi Amazon's cold 
pasta... The crisp, savory flavor of the 
vegetables spreads through my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Glad to hear it! Normally I just eyeball 
it and season by feel, though."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Measuring out seasonings carefully for a 
change made me feel like I was back to 
basics, and it was a great experience!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh... With this, we're one step closer to 
'what really matters in cooking.'

...Acting cooler than usual, Hishi Amazon 
nodded along in agreement.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're going with that one, Trainy?! 
In that case, I'll put even more muscle 
into it than usual—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Time to head back and pour some soul into 
my cooking! Brian, Hayahide, you guys were 
a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but... hang in 
there. Here, take some carrot juice with 
you as a souvenir.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Don't try to pawn it off on me in all 
the confusion, Brian.

Afterward, we returned to the academy, 
but... Hishi Amazon asked me, "Please wait 
for me in the Trainer's office."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep ya waitin', Trainer-boy. 
Here's a dish fired up with a hot soul—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Piping hot chili shrimp. Eat 'em up before 
they get cold!

Taking a bite of Hishi Amazon's chili 
shrimp... A sharp, wild spiciness spreads 
through my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Glad to hear it! Usually, I go pretty 
light on the seasoning for this kind of 
dish."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Keeping the people who eat it in mind and 
boldly going for a punchy, heavy flavor 
ain't a bad idea either!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! That's one step closer to 'what 
truly matters in cooking'--!

...Fired up more than usual, Hishi Amazon 
pumped her fist in triumph.
